content: Personal-corpus / synthetic eval evidence (peer-reviewed, cross-verified): TU Delft MSc thesis van Wolfswinkel (2026-10, repository.tudelft.nl uuid:eb09dbf7-c826-4c63-8bd4-f37f96db38d1) 'Automated Offline Evaluation of RAG Pipelines Through Synthetic Query Generation': 8 fixed pipelines ranked by synthetic doc2query vs real queries Kendall tau 0.48-0.88 (source-passage-only labels) -> 0.69-1.00 with pooled LLM relabeling; only Promptagator (few-shot in-domain query conditioning) beats naive doc2query across all datasets; synthetic queries reuse source wording (lexical bias). JMIR clinical multi-corpus bench: known-item design, BM25 keyword scores 0.266->0.856 on synthetic corpus (lexical inflation), metadata-only query variant tau 0.59-0.90. UMBRELA (TREC 2024 RAG): run-level tau>=0.86 rho>=0.97 vs human despite doc-level kappa 0.30-0.37 -> LLM judge valid for RELATIVE system ranking not absolute labels. Rahmani CIKM'25: LLM judge scores inflated ~+0.28; GPT-4 queries favor GPT-4 systems. Balog SIGIR'25 + Dietz'25 principles: judge circularity — UMBRELA tau 0.84 vs human drops to 0.63/0.44 when UMBRELA also reranks. SIGIR'26 resource paper (arXiv 2606.27559): sensitivity-aware personal-search test collection (Enron, crowdsourced 150 queries/50 topics + LLM-augmented judgments, ir_datasets).
